annotations.title: Inspect a domain before buying it

description: Gather the public record of one domain name before buying, registering or building on it: registration date, expiry and registrar, registry status (including redemption or pending delete, when a name is about to drop), whether it serves a website or receives email, Internet Archive history, HTTPS certificate history, a Wikipedia article sharing its word (a trademark flag), and the published catalog figure when there is one, with plain signals such as expires in 30 days or held but not in use. Use check_domain_availability instead to screen many names, appraise_domain for a value, and read_for_sale_dns for whether the owner lists it for sale. A source that does not answer is reported as unknown, never as absent. Read-only, free, no key; one request to the site's cached evidence lookup, runs no valuation.

domain.description: The one domain name to inspect, such as example.com. A pasted URL is accepted.

name: inspect_domain

citeAs.description: A structured citation. Quote `text` or build your own from the fields. Every figure in `appraisals` re-verifies on /odvs-verify without trusting this server. Tools whose answer is not an appraisal (a bracket, which withholds estimates by contract, and the recorded-sales tools, whose rows are not hashed) return an empty `appraisals`.

items.description: One appraisal holding exactly the fields its ODVS hashes commit to. Paste it into https://audit.domains/odvs-verify/ to recompute all three hashes client-side. appraisalHash is the appraisal's identity; resultDigest checks the output only.

confidence.description: Internal 0-100 model score, NOT a probability.

methodologyVersion.description: The methodology revision hashed into this record (as rev-<value>, or rev-n/a when null). It, not citeAs.revision, produced the figure.

edition.description: ODVS edition id; null until editions are published.

revision.description: The methodology revision live on the server at retrieval. A record's own methodologyVersion is what produced its figure and can differ.

forSale.description: Present when the owner sells it: askingPrice (indicative), buyUrl when checkout is live here, listedHere.

title: Inspect a domain before buying it
